senses.gloss:
mfn. (-रुः-रुः or -रूः-रु)
Timid, fearful.
f. (-रुः-रूः)
1 A timid woman.
2 A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.)
3 A sort of prickly night-shade.
4 A shakal.
5 A centipede.
6 A tiger.
7 A goat.
E.
भी to fear, Uṇādi aff. क्रु; also र being changed to उ, भीलु.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Timid, fearful.
2 Formidable.
n. (-कं)
A wood, a forest.
m. (-कः)
1 An owl.
2 A bear.
E.
भी to fear, Uṇādi aff. क्रुकन्; also ल being substituted for र, भीलुक.

m. (-ताः)
A deer.
E.
भीरु timid, and चेतस् disposition.

f. (-ता)
Fear, timidity, fearfulness.
E.
तल् added to भीरु; also with त्व, भीरुत्वं.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Terrific, frightful.
E.
भीरु, and मयट् aff.

m. (-न्ध्रः)
An oven, a furnace.
E.
भीरु fearful, and रन्ध्र a chasm.

m. (-यः)
A deer.
E.
भीरु timid, हृदय the heart.
